name: verify-terminal-lifecycle
description: Model-check the claudecode.nvim Claude terminal lifecycle (TLA+/TLC) against guards read from the current Lua code - the native and snacks providers, the code that finds a Claude after a plugin reload, and the provider choice (lua/claudecode/terminal.lua, terminal/native.lua, terminal/snacks.lua, terminal/owned.lua, and the terminal commands and send_at_mention in init.lua). Use after a change to how the Claude terminal is started, shown, hidden, closed, adopted, or cleaned up after Claude exits
